verdict.rationale: LegalOS publishes content built on official USCIS rules: a fee calculator for USCIS filing fees, including the Asylum Program Fee and the 50/50 rule, and a blog mapping the 10 USCIS EB-1 criteria. Its only link to uscis.gov points to blank forms, not to sources for its claims. missing for 10: citation links to official policy sources, USCIS processing-time data, FOIA statistics, and any evidence that the fee figures or criteria are sourced to government documents.

support.subject: As a developer evaluating providers, the provider grounds its public claims in government data — USCIS processing data, FOIA statistics, or official policy citations with links

citations.quote: Instantly estimate USCIS filing fees—including the Asylum Program Fee and Premium Processing
the 10 USCIS EB-1 criteria mapped to actual engineering careers
If you are looking for blank forms, they are available for free at www.uscis.gov.
